mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendant (user_id, certificate, status, qualification_fail_reason, introduction, professional_field, score, experience_years, hospital_name) VALUES (#{userId}, #{certificate}, #{status}, #{qualificationFailReason}, #{introduction}, #{professionalField}, #{score}, #{experienceYears}, #{hospitalName})
mapper.select: SELECT a.*, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 6 THEN 1 END) AS service_count FROM attendant a LEFT JOIN `order` o ON o.attendant_id = a.user_id WHERE a.status = 1 GROUP BY a.user_id ORDER BY service_count DESC, a.score DESC, a.experience_years DESC, a.update_time DESC LIMIT 10
